<!-- Reference: 'Under A Rock' game, by Nordic Trolls -->
Small groups of dodos can be found on [[island]] [[beach]]es, where they were domesticated first by a lost population of terribly malformed [[troglodyte|humans]]. [[Animal trainer]]s traditionally first knock the dodo unconscious, then feed it purple berries or tiny [[Cook#Prepared Meal|biscuits]] to earn its trust.
